source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
In the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) or your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), when **selected to attack**, this unit's attacks can gain one of these:

- **[[LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)**
- **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits-1-non-monster-vehicle)**
- both, if this unit has the **tactical doctrine** of [Combat Doctrines](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines) active
